picks.editorial_note: A White House-backed, 15-university, 10-state supercomputing consortium marks a major federal push to build shared 'superintelligence' compute infrastructure — a policy-level signal of how seriously the government is investing in regional AI research capacity.
picks.title: UK partners with regional universities in super intelligence computing consortium

picks.editorial_note: DOE's Genesis Mission, linking national supercomputers, datasets, and experimental facilities for AI-accelerated discovery, represents a flagship national science initiative with implications for how federal research infrastructure is organized around AI.
picks.title: NAE Annual Meeting Spotlights DOE’s New Genesis Project and Other AI Initiatives Aimed at Advancing Discovery

picks.editorial_note: Georgia Tech's $20M NSF-funded Nexus supercomputer, opened to researchers nationwide in partnership with UIUC, substantially expands shared AI compute access for the broader academic research community.
picks.title: Georgia Tech Opens Supercomputer to Researchers Nationwide

picks.editorial_note: A $19.2 million, five-year Army Research Office award to a UCF-led team to study light propagation via AI-driven computational imaging is a major defense-research investment with broad sensing and imaging applications.
picks.title: UCF-Led Team Receives $19.2 Million Army Research Office Award to Advance the Science of Light

picks.editorial_note: ASU's Intel-backed AI Research Acceleration Platform democratizes supercomputing access for all students and researchers, an important model for broadening participation in AI-enabled research.
picks.title: ASU provides access to AI-supercomputing for all

picks.editorial_note: Google.org's $5 million commitment to Georgia Tech for AI-for-science infrastructure reflects deepening industry investment in academic scientific discovery tools.
picks.title: Georgia Tech Receives $5 Million From Google.org to Expand Access to AI for Scientific Discovery

picks.editorial_note: UIUC's ESMDynamic model dramatically speeds up prediction of protein motion compared to traditional molecular dynamics simulations, a genuine scientific advance with major implications for structural biology and drug discovery.
picks.title: AI model offers a faster way to explore how proteins move, study finds

picks.editorial_note: University of Arkansas's AURORA robotic, AI-enhanced cloud laboratory for discovering quantum materials showcases a novel 'self-driving lab' approach that could accelerate materials science broadly.
picks.title: Robots and AI Could Speed Search for Quantum Materials

picks.editorial_note: NJIT spinout OppyAI's 'Neural Crypto' hybrid AI, which lets organizations use cloud-scale AI while keeping data private, tackles a real commercial pain point and shows academic research translating into a globally viable product.
picks.title: NJIT Spinout OppyAI Takes Private Hybrid AI to the Global Stage

picks.editorial_note: Georgia Tech researchers' work detecting internal warning signs of unsafe LLM behavior, motivated by a real 2026 incident, addresses a pressing AI-safety research gap with direct policy relevance.
picks.title: Can We Detect Harmful AI Before It’s Too Late? Researchers Search for Warning Signs
